name: Corban University
descriptionText: Cascade Collegiate Conference Visit Corban University Athletics is committed to fielding teams of Christian student athletes who represent Christ and the University at a top level of competition. Athletics at Corban exists to integrate and enhance the mission of the University, while providing student-athletes and the college community opportunities for spiritual, academic, and athletic growth and development. We understand, from the Christian perspective, that competition is healthy for growing maturing Christians student-athletes. Studentathletes who are fortunate enough to be a Warrior are provided and challenged with enriched, quality, and competitive intercollegiate athletic opportunities at a national level. Personal growth is highly emphasized and enhanced by combining spiritual truth into athletic and academic achievement. Coaches actively recruit student-athletes who are committed to developing Christlike character through discipline, teamwork, competition, and ministry. It is a primary goal that all our young men and women display that character and attitude toward opponents, spectators, officials and the community. Student-athletes at Corban can expect to be challenged, instructed, encouraged and mentored in the process of growing and living life in the image of Jesus Christ. As a member of the Cascade Collegiate Conference (CCC), Corban is affiliated with the National Association of Intercollegiate Athletics (NAIA). Warrior teams compete in women's basketball, cross country, track & field, golf, soccer, softball, lacrosse, volleyball and beach volleyball along with the men's sports of basketball, baseball, cross country, track & field, golf, wrestling and soccer. Corban has claimed 43 CCC Championships (23 regular-season championships; 20 tournament championships) since all Warrior sports joined the CCC in 1994. Since joining the NAIA prior to the 1970-71 year, Corban University has competed in 44 regional tournament and 83 national tournaments. In 2022, the Corban beach volleyball team claimed the inaugural NAIA Beach Volleyball National Invitational, Robert Swoboda won the individual national title in the NAIA Track & Field 10,000-meter race, and Valerie Schmidt was crowned the NAIA National Champion in the heptathlon. The 2022-23 school year featured a pair of NAIA National Tournament Runner-Up team titles for the women's volleyball and beach volleyball programs, where the NAIA National Attacker of the Year (Rylee Troutman) and NAIA Most Valuable Player (Avari Ridgway) paved the way for the two powerhouse rosters. On an individual basis, Corban men's wrestling standout student-athlete David Rubio set the new standard for the young program, securing his second consecutive CCC Championship at the 165-weight class and finishing as the National Runner-Up at the NAIA National Tournament, the highest individual finish in program history.

descriptionText: Southern States Athletic Conference Visit Nestled in the heart of Pulaski, TN, the University of Tennessee Southern is dedicated to putting students first, catering to the diverse needs of our small-town community. At UT Southern, excellence is not just a goal—it's our commitment to every student who walks through our doors.
